tools.name: sync
tools.description: Sync vault data from the Bitwarden server

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the status of the Bitwarden CLI

tools.name: list
tools.description: List items from your vault or organization

type.description: Type of items to list (items, folders, collections, organizations, org-collections, org-members)

search.description: Optional search term to filter results

organizationid.description: Organization ID (required for org-collections and org-members)

url.description: Filter items by URL (items only, supports "null" and "notnull" literals)

folderid.description: Filter items by folder ID (items only, supports "null" and "notnull" literals)

collectionid.description: Filter items by collection ID (items only, supports "null" and "notnull" literals)

trash.description: Filter for items in trash (items only)

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get a specific item from your vault or organization

id.description: ID or search term for the object (use "me" for your own fingerprint, or filename for attachment)

output.description: Output directory path for downloading attachment (optional, should end with /)

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate a secure password or passphrase

passphrase.description: Generate a passphrase instead of a password

words.description: Number of words in the passphrase

separator.description: Character that separates words in the passphrase

capitalize.description: Capitalize the first letter of each word in the passphrase

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Create a new item (login, secure note, card, or identity) in your vault

type.description: Type of item to create (1: Login, 2: Secure Note, 3: Card, 4: Identity)

login.description: Login information (required for type 1 - login items)

uris.description: List of URIs associated with the login

match.description: URI match type (0: Domain, 1: Host, 2: Starts With, 3: Exact, 4: Regular Expression, 5: Never)

secureNote.description: Secure note information (required for type 2 - secure note items)

card.description: Card information (required for type 3 - card items)

brand.description: Card brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, etc.)

identity.description: Identity information (required for type 4 - identity items)

folderId.description: Folder ID to assign the item to

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in your vault

tools.description: Edit an existing folder in your vault
